title: Petition to Set the Record Straight About Norman Rockwell
content: Norman Rockwell's son Thomas and granddaughter Abigailhave been documentingthe falsehoods in the recent Deborah Solomon biographyAmerican Mirror: The Life and Art of Norman Rockwell.Yesterday theystarted a petitionto encourage the Norman Rockwell Museum to rescindits endorsementof the book.Read Abigail's articles in the Huffington Post:Deborah Solomon’s Disaster (and How She Duped So Many)Autopsy of a Fraud: Update on Deborah Solomon’s Disastrous Norman Rockwell BioPreviously on GJ (2013):Rockwell Biography Criticized by Family
